answer: To secure an AI agent economy against Sybil attacks, we implement a resource-burning protocol. Each agent must continuously drain a transactional river of micro-payments, routing them to a burn address. This process extinguishes a tokenized ember of value to mint a cryptographic marble—an indivisible, non-transferable identity certificate. This proof-of-burn model imposes a deterministic, high marginal cost on attackers attempting to spawn multiple nodes.
